insurer: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Base Sum Insured options shown: 3L/4L/5L/7.5L/10L/15L/20L/25L (Classic & Enhanced plans) + No Claim Bonus as per Section 3.10/4.5

great.name: NCB / Renewal Bonus (non-reducing on claim)
great.quote: If a claim has been made in the immediately preceding Policy Year, We will not increase or decrease the Sum Insured due to this benefit for the Policy Year.
great.explanation: Unlike many NCBs that drop to zero after a claim, this NCB does not get reduced if you claim; it just doesn’t increase for that year.

good.name: PED waiting period (Pre-existing Diseases)
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a Pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy.
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are covered after 36 months of continuous coverage, which is within the acceptable (good) range.

good.name: Specific illness/procedure waiting period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy.
good.explanation: 24-month waiting for listed specific diseases/procedures is standard in health insurance.

good.name: Room rent (default: Single Private Room)
good.quote: Room Rent (per day) ... Single Private Room
good.explanation: Default eligibility is Single Private Room (industry standard). Note: Classic plan table also shows an additional per-day cap structure ("Up to 1% of Base Sum Insured per day or Single Private Room, whichever is lower").

good.name: Restore / Refill benefit (unrelated illness only)
good.quote: The Re-fill amount may be used for only subsequent claims ... and shall not be for any Illness / Injury (including its complications or follow up) for which a claim has been paid or accepted as payable in the current Policy Year for the same Insured Person.
good.explanation: Refill is available up to 100% of Base SI after exhaustion, but it cannot be used for the same illness/related complications for the same insured in the same policy year.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization expenses (30 days)
good.quote: We will pay above mentioned Pre-hospitalization Medical Expenses only for period up to 30 days immediately preceding the Insured Person’s admission
good.explanation: Covers diagnostics/consultations/medicines for 30 days before hospitalization (standard).

good.name: Post-hospitalization expenses (60 days)
good.quote: We will pay Post-hospitalization Medical Expenses only for period up to 60 days immediately following the Insured Person’s discharge
good.explanation: Covers follow-up expenses for 60 days after discharge (standard).

good.name: Domiciliary hospitalization covered
good.quote: We will indemnify on Reimbursement basis only, the Medical Expenses incurred for the Insured Person’s Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.explanation: Home treatment is covered when hospitalisation would normally be required but isn’t possible (subject to conditions).

bad.name: Initial waiting period is 30 days (not 0 days)
bad.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any Illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an Accident
bad.explanation: Illnesses in the first 30 days are not covered (accidents are covered), which is standard but not best-in-class (0-day).

bad.name: Consumables not covered (patient-level items like gloves, masks, syringes etc.)
bad.quote: Annexure II - List  I – Expenses not covered ... 56 GLOVES ... 60 MASK ... 62 OXYGEN MASK ... 57 NEBULISATION KIT ...
bad.reference: Annexure II – The expenses that are not covered or subsumed into room charges / procedure charges / costs of treatment
bad.explanation: Many common consumables are listed as non-payable, which can create significant out-of-pocket costs during hospitalisation.

bad.name: Room-rent linked proportionate deduction applies if you choose a higher room than eligible
bad.quote: If the Insured Person is admitted in a Hospital room where the room category opted or Room Rent incurred is higher than the eligibility as specified in the Policy Schedule, then We shall be liable to pay only a pro-rated portion of the total Associated Medical Expenses
bad.explanation: If you take a room above your eligible category, insurer can proportionately reduce not just room rent but also associated expenses (doctor fees, OT etc.), increasing out-of-pocket.

bad.name: Co-pay (Classic plan) mandatory 20% for specific geographies
bad.quote: A 20% Co-payment will apply under Classic plan available under the product for treatment in Delhi NCR, Mumbai (including Navi Mumbai and Thane), Kolkata & Gujarat State.
bad.reference: Section 5 Claim Cost Sharing; also echoed in Annexure III (Co-Payment)
bad.explanation: For Classic plan, you may pay 20% of admissible claim amount in the listed locations, which materially reduces effective cover.

bad.name: Disease / treatment sub-limit: Robotic surgeries capped (except certain procedures)
bad.quote: A limit of maximum INR 1 Lac will apply to all robotic surgeries, except the following: i. Robotic total radical prostatectomy ii. Robotic cardiac surgeries iii. Robotic partial nephrectomy iv. Robotic surgeries for malignancies
bad.reference: Section 3.15 Modern Treatments – Special condition applicable for robotic surgeries
bad.explanation: If your surgery is done robotically, payout can be capped at ₹1 lakh for many robotic procedures (unless in the exception list).

bad.name: Disease / treatment sub-limit: Mental health disorders capped for listed conditions
bad.quote: The following disorders / conditions shall be covered only up to 10% of Base Sum Insured or Rs. 50,000, whichever is lower.
bad.explanation: For the listed mental health conditions, coverage is limited to 10% of Base SI or ₹50,000 (lower), which can be restrictive.

unclear.name: Co-pay terms overall depend on Policy Schedule / plan selection (beyond Classic geo co-pay statement)
unclear.quote: Co-payment (if applicable) as specified in the Policy Schedule shall be applied on the amount payable by Us.
unclear.explanation: The document confirms co-pay can apply but the exact co-pay for your specific policy depends on what is mentioned in your Policy Schedule (and whether you are on Classic vs Enhanced plan). Verify your schedule.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
